en.headline: Councillor inspects Hung Hom alley after footage shows rats beside restaurant
en.dek: District councillor Lam Tak-shing visited the Baker Circle site with the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department on Tuesday and called for stepped-up patrols and rodent control.
body: A district councillor inspected a back alley in Hung Hom’s Baker Circle on Tuesday after footage circulated showing more than a dozen rats moving near a chain restaurant.

Lam Tak-shing visited the site with officers from the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department, mall management and property management representatives. He asked the mall operator to step up patrols of passages, back alleys, refuse rooms and drains, conduct regular rodent control and manage waste properly.

Lam said residents had reported the problem in the alley next to the long-established restaurant, which has heavy foot traffic from residents, office workers and takeaway customers. He described the infestation as a major hidden risk to public health, food safety and the district’s hygiene image. The alley is next to a construction site.

zh.headline: 區議員視察紅碩貝克圓環後巷鼠患 要求加強滅鼠
zh.dek: 林志成周二聯同食環署及商場管理人員到場，要求加強巡查後巷、垃圾房及排水渠，並定期滅鼠。
body: 網上片段顯示紅碩貝克圓環一間連鎖餐廳旁後巷有逾十隻老鼠活動，區議員林志成周二聯同食物環境衞生署人員、商場及物業管理代表到場視察。
林志成要求商場營運商加強巡查通道、後巷、垃圾房及排水渠，定期進行滅鼠工作，並妥善處理廢物。他指居民早前已投訴該後巷有鼠患，餐廳人流多，服務居民、上班族及外賣顧客。
他認為鼠患對公眾健康、食物安全及區內衞生形象構成重大隱患。後巷旁正有地盤施工。
